reviews.text: From the reception to Dr. Cesar, the care you feel is ❤️. Thank you 🦮 …

Excellent professionals, my Sissy will be eternally grateful for the treatment provided!
Thank you very much!
Veterinarian for all the dogs and cats in the family for years! I trust Dr. César completely!

Dr. César is, without a doubt, an excellent veterinarian and, above all, a true example of professionalism, empathy, and dedication.

He has been caring for my pets – and my family's pets – for many years, and has always demonstrated exceptional care. He has the gift of knowing how to distinguish a simple situation from something more serious, and I have witnessed cases where his attentive diagnosis was confirmed by tests, demonstrating his competence and experience.

Dr. César closely follows all phases, including hospitalizations, always proving to be attentive, helpful, and present, even in the most delicate situations. Besides being a veterinarian, he is a true source of support and confidence for pet owners and animals.

I sincerely thank him for all the care and dedication he has shown. Professionals with this level of commitment and humanity are a rarity these days – and a true gift.

Dr. César is an excellent veterinarian and, above all, a true example of professionalism, empathy, and dedication. In almost two years of dealing with him, and despite several health setbacks for my babies Laurent and Dupont, Dr. César has never stopped monitoring them or asking about them, even outside of office hours. I trust him and the clinic completely, and I can only thank him for all the advice and the way he treats my little ones. Excellent in his dealings with people and animals! I can only recommend his services!! Thank you very much.

Unfortunately, in the more than 20 years that I have known the clinic, I can say that, on a professional level, the lack of empathy and professionalism has become apparent over time. Furthermore, the diagnostic equipment is from the Stone Age, excuse the expression, and medicine, whatever it may be, needs to keep up with constant evolution, something that hasn't happened here.
Lack of professionalism, lack of empathy, and lack of technical knowledge. Incompetent with animals and their owners. I do not recommend.
He's been taking care of family pets for over 20 years! A great professional and a friend. I always recommend him!!
Impeccable from the initial phone call to the in-person service. Dr. César was super attentive, and my Zaily loved it.
Dr. César is a wonderful veterinarian and takes great care of our Moana. She is timid, but he calms her down, and I appreciate his humanity and attention.
Dr. César is the best veterinarian in Lisbon. Fudge and Oli have complete faith in his abilities, which is why I don't go to any other veterinarian.
Dr. César is an amazing veterinarian. Our four-legged friends couldn't have a better doctor, and we owners are privileged to have a friend as well. Thank you.
